name: Marisol Reyes-Tan
oneLine: Middle school science teacher and department lead in Las Vegas, on an H-1B, who built her district's Canvas unit library and wants to move into instructional design at an ed-tech company or corporate L&D team.

stories.title: Mojave Valley School District (Harmon Ridge Middle School)

companies.name: Lanternwise
companies.why: Millions of people finish real courses there, and I'd love to help experts turn what they know into something learners actually complete.

companies.name: Skillharbor
companies.why: Skillharbor Business designs training for working adults, which feels like the corporate L&D side I want to try.

companies.name: Chirpwise
companies.why: They test everything with learners and the lessons are tiny and well sequenced, which is exactly how I like to design.

companies.name: Northbeam Learning
companies.why: Middle school science curriculum written by former teachers, so it's basically my unit library at scale.

postings.title: Instructional Designer, Course Development
postings.why: Instructional design with assessments, LMS course building and learner data; remote US, $95k–$120k, considers H-1B transfers, travel under 10%.

postings.title: Learning Experience Designer, Skillharbor Business
postings.why: Learning experience design for workplace learners, storyboards, playtesting and workshops; remote US, $100k–$130k, supports visa transfers, one trip a year.

postings.title: Curriculum Designer, Middle School Science
postings.why: Content is a near-perfect match and pay ($88k–$104k), remote and travel are fine, but it cannot sponsor or take over H-1B sponsorship, which she needs.
